name_entry_surface_label: Example State official voter-information name-entry fail-open policy
delivery_role_note: Critical official voter-information routes that depend on a personal name keep name structure, character support, optional-name-part handling, and match-recovery cues clear enough that the current official answer does not depend on a Western-only name model or a brittle exact-match parser.
full_name_vs_split_fields_note: Critical routes use a single full-name field unless the service materially needs separate name parts; when split fields are required, the reason is task-specific rather than assumed.
registration_record_name_scope_note: If a lookup expects the registration-record name, previous name, or another record-specific variant, that expectation is visible before failure occurs.
punctuation_diacritics_case_and_length_s: Name fields support ordinary punctuation, spaces, diacritics, short names, and long names without brittle rejection or hidden coercion of displayed review text.
single_name_and_optional_parts_note: Middle, family, title, and suffix fields remain optional unless the route can justify them as materially necessary to the task.
title_suffix_and_previous_name_note: If title, suffix, preferred-name, or previous-name fields are present, the route explains whether they are optional and whether they affect the lookup outcome.
autofill_and_programmatic_name_tokens_no: Where appropriate, the route uses task-accurate labels and autocomplete/name-purpose cues so full-name, given-name, family-name, or repeated-name groups stay distinct.
name_variant_and_match_recovery_note: A mismatch preserves the entered value, explains the next bounded retry or alternate-name step, and keeps first-party help visible instead of clearing the form.
no_hidden_normalization_or_context_chang: Typing or editing a name does not silently submit the route, reroute the page, or hide how punctuation, spacing, or case were normalized for matching.
same_answer_across_name_entry_variants_n: Full-name, split-field, pasted, and autofilled variants resolve to the same authoritative answer or the same explainable recovery posture for the same person.
